title: Filer Class Applied to Named Non-Owner Policy Package-Change Increase Charges
content:
For an increase charge on a mid-term Named Non-Owner Policy package change, the named insured's Operator certificate requirement on the day of the change sets a filer class.

**The requirement read.** It is an SR-22 Operator Certificate or FR-44 Operator Certificate filing of the named insured, as recorded with the Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) product. For each form the filing read is its requested filing, otherwise its filed one, otherwise its rejected one, the one recorded first within a status, and that filing counts when its required-through date is on or after the day of the change or is not recorded; no other filing of the form is read when it does not. When both forms count, the FR-44 one counts. Withdrawn, terminated and cancellation-filed filings, Owner and Owner-Operator certificates, and the term's own record of the certificate it was written to back are not read.

| Requirement counted | 6 or more violation points | fewer than 6 violation points |
|---|---|---|
| FR-44 | 1.35 | 1.25 |
| SR-22 | 1.15 | 1.08 |
| none | none | none |

The class multiplies the increase rated premium before the deduction is subtracted, and before the charge is rounded to the cent. A named insured with no such requirement carries no such class.

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- An FR-44 filed, required through a date after the day of the change, 6 points: 1.35. The same with 5 points: 1.25.
- A requested FR-44 whose required-through date fell before the day of the change, and a filed FR-44 still current: the requested one is the filing read for the form and it does not count, so no FR-44 requirement counts; an SR-22 that counts would then give its class.
- An SR-22 filed with no required-through date recorded, 0 points: 1.08.
- Only an Owner-Operator certificate: none.
